name: claude-mem
description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
one_liner: Gives your AI coding assistant a memory, so it remembers your project the next time you open it instead of starting from zero.
buyer: An indie developer or small team running long multi-day projects with Claude Code, Codex or similar tools, frustrated by re-explaining context every session.
business_use_cases: A solo developer keeps a months-long side project moving without re-explaining architecture decisions each session.
A freelancer switches between several client codebases per day and relies on it to keep each project's context separate and intact.
A dev tooling startup embeds similar memory-compression tech into their own AI product as a feature.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted/managed memory service with backup and team-sharing for a monthly fee.
Sell setup and tuning consulting to teams adopting it across multiple AI coding tools.

steal_this: This weekend, build a tiny hosted version that syncs memory across a freelancer's multiple client laptops, and sell it as a $10/month add-on.
